wizardPose: Sit upright, look at the camera, then set 0°.
otherTab: A session is running in another tab
takenOver: Another tab took over. Camera released.
camDenied: Camera permission denied. Allow this site, then try again.
modelFail: Face Landmarker failed to load. Landmarks will not be faked.
fps: FPS (measured on this device, not a product claim)
youtubeInvalid: Couldn't read a video ID from that link
localDataNotice: Pomodoro data (tasks, settings, sessions completed) is stored only in this browser — clearing site data deletes it.
pipHint: Open a small always-on-top HUD while you work in other windows
notifyDenied: System notifications are blocked — while this tab is hidden, alerts are voice-only. Allow notifications in site settings to get them.
camBusy: The camera is in use by another app (Zoom, Meet, OBS…). Close it, then try again.
camInsecure: This page must be opened over HTTPS to use the camera.
